note_title: 展开后交换求和与积分次序
summary_en: This note discusses a general technique for rewriting a difficult sum or integral by expanding part of the integrand or summand into a new series or integral and then exchanging the order of summation and integration. It emphasizes when such rearrangements are useful, especially for power-series expansions and moment computations, and illustrates the method with examples from complex analysis and special-function integrals.

problems.statement_en: Example: Compare the power-series representation and the integral representation of a holomorphic function, viewing the power series as obtained by expanding the Cauchy integral formula internally and then exchanging the order. Use this perspective to understand why the power-series form is better for local zero analysis, while the integral form is better for deriving global growth properties.
problems.statement_zh: 例子0.1：全纯函数的幂级数表示与积分表示。比如全纯函数的积分表示，即柯西积分公式，通过内部做展开的方式，然后交换得到函数的幂级数表示。讨论其在零点局部分析与全局增长条件分析中的不同适用性。
key_techniques: power series representation of holomorphic functions

problems.statement_en: Proposition 3.1.3: For common functions on $[0,+\infty)$, compute the moments $b_n:=\int_0^{\infty}g(x)x^n\,dx$. In particular: for $g(x)=e^{-ax}$, show $b_n=\frac{n!}{a^{n+1}}$; for $g(x)=e^{-ax^2}$, show $b_n=\frac{\Gamma((n+1)/2)}{2a^{(n+1)/2}}$; for $g(x)=\frac{1}{e^x-1}$, show $b_n=n!\zeta(n+1)$; for $g(x)=\frac{1}{e^x+1}$, show $b_n=n!(1-2^{-n})\zeta(n+1)$.
problems.statement_zh: 命题3.1.3: 正半轴上指数衰减的函数n次矩。区间$[0,+\infty)$上常见的$n$次矩简单的函数$g(x)$以及它们的$n$次矩$b_n:=\int_0^{\infty}g(x)x^n\,dx$：指数衰减型$e^{-ax}$；高斯函数$e^{-ax^2}$；玻色-爱因斯坦分布（简化）$\frac{1}{e^x-1}$；费米-狄拉克分布（简化）$\frac{1}{e^x+1}$。

problems.statement_en: Let $a>0$, $b\in\mathbb{R}$, and assume $a>|b|$. Compute the parameter integral $I(a,b):=\int_0^{\infty}e^{-ax}J_0(bx)\,dx$, where $J_0(z)$ is the Bessel function of the first kind of order $0$.
problems.statement_zh: 例子3.1.5：令$a>0,b\in \mathbb{R}$并且满足$a>|b|$，计算含参数积分$$I(a,b):=\int_0^{\infty}e^{-ax}J_0(bx)\,dx$$其中$J_0(z)$是第一类零阶贝塞尔函数。

key_techniques_discussed: expand part of an integrand or summand into a series
exchange the order of summation and integration
choosing a representation adapted to local versus global analysis
using geometric-series expansions for Bose-Einstein and Fermi-Dirac type kernels
connections_mentioned: isolated zeros and the identity theorem
